spec.assertion: Application count must equal floor(brid's rounds fired / 30) ±2, where rounds are counted from her own shot/normal-hit events. Fails under the nearest-wrong burst-cast keying (patching skill1's trigger to burstCast drops applications to <15 and to under a third of the round-driven count) — i.e. it discriminates a ROUND counter from any per-cast or per-Full-Burst trigger.

Every buff brid casts emits stat 'atkPct' with value 18.52 (a raw percentage). Fails under the nearest-wrong caster-scaled encoding (casterAtkPct/highestAllyAtkPct re-emit flat-resolved ATK, not 18.52) and under any normal-attack-scoped stat.

buffApply carries a finite expiresFrame and NO durationShots (wall-clock, not a 'for N round(s)' window); scaling the authored durationSec x6 must RAISE brid's total and x0.05 must LOWER it. Fails under a permanent buff (both patches inert) and under a round-count window (durationShots present). The x6 leg doubles as the non-vacuity proof: it can only add damage if base uptime is below 100%, so the fixture exercises both the buffed and unbuffed state.
No buff cast by brid has targetSlug !== 'brid'. Fails under the nearest-wrong allies scope, which is separately shown to be observable (patching target to allies moves liter's and crown's totals).

Emptying the skill2 slot must lower brid's total, so the line is live and non-vacuous. Magnitude itself is not asserted numerically because the hit rides her live ATK (skill1 window) and Full-Burst timing; the trigger assertions below carry the discrimination.

Two nearest-wrong readings are excluded without pinning a cadence: patching the trigger to shotFired must more than double brid's total (so the shipped model is not already per-shot), and patching it to fullBurstEnter must change her total (so it is not already FB-keyed). The exact period is an it.skip — the prose states no trigger, so any specific interval/hit-count is an ALWAYS-⛑ invented value.
Single-boss fight: the highest-final-DEF enemy is the only enemy, so target selection is unobservable and carries no assertion. Recorded here so it is not read as a silent drop.
Emptying the burst slot must lower brid's total while she still casts (a burstCast event is still emitted), proving the damage rides the burst block and not the rotation.

spec.kitLine: same target when at Max HP
spec.assertion: Burst contribution must contain exactly ONE 1440% instance: duplicating the burst's flatDamage effect must exactly double the burst's damage delta (ratio 2.00 +/- 0.05). Fails at ratio 1.50 under the nearest-wrong always-on two-instance model. Reasoning: the target is the enemy, and a 180s raid boss is below Max HP from the first second while brid's earliest cast is many seconds in. ⛑ FORK FLAGGED: if the clause is instead read as gating on the CASTER's HP, then at scope lock (immortal boss, nobody takes damage) brid is permanently at Max HP and the branch would ALWAYS apply — a x2 swing on her burst. The prose's subject is 'the same target', so this spec takes the enemy reading and this assertion is deliberately the one that goes RED if the shipped model took the other fork.

Not asserted per-bucket: burst-cast damage is engine-ruled to land before Full Burst opens (no +50%, no entry auras), which is a shared primitive already pinned by the engine suites rather than a per-unit kit claim.

fixtures: controlComp('brid') only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / brid (B3) / helm (B3), boss Fire, focus brid, deterministic (no seed). The control core is mandatory, not incidental: brid is a Burst III unit and a lone B3 makes ZERO Full Bursts, so a solo fixture could never cast her burst or exercise the burst-slot lines at all. helm is kept (fixed-B3 flag true) because her ally buff is critRateNormalPct — scoped to normal attacks — so it cannot confound the skill2/burst function-damage readings, and every burst/skill2 assertion is a DELTA against a counterfactual run of the same comp, which cancels the shared team buffs entirely. 10 hoisted runs (base + 9 counterfactuals), each a full 180s sim.
gaps: it.skip — exact cadence of the skill2 211.2% line: the kit prose states NO activation clause, so both the trigger kind and its period are invented values (the ALWAYS-⚑ 'damage line with no stated trigger' case). Asserting a specific interval would be guessing a precise ⚑. Recipe: read the datamined skill cooldown for skill2, or count 211.2%-tier popups per magazine on a focus recording, then pin the period here.

NOT an it.skip but flagged as a genuine model fork: the burst's 'when at Max HP' clause. This spec asserts the single-instance (enemy-below-max-HP) reading. The alternative caster-HP reading would be permanently TRUE at scope lock and doubles her burst — the two readings are behaviourally x2 apart, and only prose/footage arbitration can settle it. Recipe: read the burst popup count/values on a brid focus recording — one 1440%-tier popup per cast versus two.
